player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop trying to open the wardrobe, but I never actually tried to open it in a way that the game master would understand. The game master kept saying "I don't know what you mean" because I was using the wrong verb or phrase. Next time, I will try to use more specific and game-master-friendly language, such as "open the wardrobe door" or "open the wardrobe with a handle". If that doesn't work, I will try to use more general actions like "examine the wardrobe" or "look at the wardrobe" to see if I can get more information about how to interact with it.
